h1: Discover a New Way of Living in Manchester.
intro: Three developments in Manchester city centre, with direct rail to London in around two hours.
about: Manchester's property market spans everything from Victorian terraces to brand-new towers.
The northern city centre is in the middle of a renewal, increasingly known for independent coffee shops, craft breweries and street food traders rather than chain retail.
Metrolink trams link the city centre to Spinningfields, the Northern Quarter and MediaCityUK.

items.note: Food halls, a short walk away.
Riverside bars, a short walk away.
Vintage shops and live music venues, just beyond.
The office district, under twenty minutes on foot or by tram.
Cobbled lanes and Chetham's, a short stroll away.

items.title: Transport
items.text: Manchester Victoria and Manchester Piccadilly are both within easy walking distance of Dutton Street, with direct rail to London in around two hours.

items.title: Roads
items.text: The M60 and M602 are close by for wider Greater Manchester travel.

items.title: Entertainment
items.text: Manchester Arena and the Printworks entertainment complex are close enough to reach without a car.

items.title: Green space
items.text: Angel Meadow Park, the River Irwell towpath and Manchester Cathedral gardens are close by.
